note: OWNED inventory (ARIA-20261007-2253): the historical purchase price is SUNK basis and is recorded but never decides a rehab/sell/keep choice; decisions use incremental cash from today. A past tow proves the trailer ran once, not that it is roadworthy now: the tow is seller_stated until inspected.

fields.ask: What did you pay for it, roughly, and when? (Recorded as sunk history; it will not drive the decision.)
Describe the last tow you made with it (route, distance, how it tracked). I record it as what you said, not as proof it is roadworthy now.
Tire size, date code and condition?
Do both burners light and hold a flame? Anything leaking?
Any cracks, bent members, rust-through or weak welds on frame, tongue or deck? Where?
What is wrong with the shocks or springs, and does it sit level and track straight?
Bearings: when last repacked or replaced? Any heat, noise or play?
Do all lights work? Plug type?
Do you have a title, registration or bill of sale, and does the VIN or tag match?
Overall length, width and weight if known?
What welding or rework do you already know it needs?
Theme or cosmetic ideas (colors, chrome bumper, accessories)?
If you only did the necessary repairs, what outside parts or materials would you buy? Rough range.
For the themed build, what extra parts, paint or chrome would you buy? Rough range.
Roughly how many of your own hours for the minimal path and for the themed path?
Would you keep and use it yourself? How much is that worth to you?
When do you want it sold or in use (tailgate season dates)?
